key_decisions.decision: Preserves the funeral burning custom without asserting cremation or an unstated material.
Makes enslavement explicit and preserves male and female slaves and the brother relationship.
Preserves both agreement and actual release rather than reducing it to an unfulfilled pledge.
Follows the read subjugation verb and makes the violent reversal explicit.
Preserves both seven and six rather than silently harmonizing the timing.
Retains the repeated turning now used negatively and the freedom forcibly removed.
Keeps the bitter freedom wordplay and all three threatened disasters.
Makes the implied comparison explicit while preserving the cut-animal covenant rite.
Retains all participating groups and the repeated passage between pieces.
Preserves the unburied bodies and both scavenging groups.
